program.section_heading: Vocational Nursing AS Degree — Licensed Vocational Nursing (VN/LVN)
outcomes: Integrate leadership principles in a variety of healthcare settings.
Demonstrate the Professional Identity of the VN
Employ clinical judgement, rooted in evidence-based practice to provide nursing care at an entry level for a vocational nurse.
Prioritize client-centered care that recognizes the client as a full partner with individual preferences and beliefs.
Facilitate communication with the interprofessional health care team for the purpose of improving patient outcomes.
Implement all aspects of safety through systems-based approach and individual practice.
